title: confirm_entities directive payload
description: The DataPart 'data' object of a confirm_entities handoff directive. Delivered on a TaskStatusUpdateEvent that sets state to INPUT_REQUIRED (spec §7, §7.1). Supports two-phase confirmation before a sensitive or destructive operation. The Live layer confirms with the caller and resumes on the same contextId and taskId.

entities.description: The entities/details to confirm before the sensitive action proceeds.

responseSchema.description: JSON Schema describing the confirmation result the Live layer returns on resume.
